{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies the hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be applied (e.g., before or after final machining). Without a defined stage, the machinist cannot sequence operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features. The designer should add when in the process the toughening must occur.","recommended_correction":"Revise N1 to specify the heat-treatment stage, for example: 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL MACHINING.'"},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The part carries an I.Z.B.P. surface treatment per the title block, and D24 specifies a tight ⌀8 H7 hole, yet no allowance is made for plating thickness on this fit. Plating buildup will reduce the bore below its H7 limit and prevent the mating pin from fitting. The designer should either mask the H7 holes during plating or adjust the pre-plate hole size to account for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the ⌀8 H7 holes are to be masked during plating, or increase the pre-plate hole diameter by twice the maximum plating thickness so the finished size remains within H7."}]}
